<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" type="device"><diagram id="architecture" name="Klubcamp architecture"><mxGraphModel dx="1200" dy="1050" grid="1" gridSize="10" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1200" pageHeight="1050"><root><mxCell id="0"/><mxCell id="1" parent="0"/> <mxCell id="heading" value="KLUBCAMP | Solution architecture
Deployed bootstrap + approved direction | 7 November 2026" style="text;html=0;align=left;fontSize=24;fontStyle=1;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="40" y="25" width="1120" height="65" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="legend" value="Solid blue: implemented locally | Dashed amber: planned or not verified in production" style="text;align=left;fontSize=14;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="40" y="95" width="1120" height="30" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="hosting" value="Deployed: Hetzner Webhosting L | camps.schwarzweisskoeln.de" style="rounded=1;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=15;align=left;spacingLeft=20;fillColor=#fffbeb;strokeColor=#b7791f;dashed=1;fontSize=17;fontStyle=1;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="360" y="150" width="800" height="490" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="browser" value="Browser / React SPA
TypeScript + Vite build
Current: connectivity page
Future: parents, trainers, office" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;fillColor=#eaf3ff;strokeColor=#3973ac;fontSize=16;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="40" y="235" width="260" height="145" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="server" value="Node.js 24 / Express
One app serves frontend/dist + JSON API
GET /api/health (application only)
Unknown /api routes: JSON 404" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#eaf3ff;strokeColor=#3973ac;fontSize=16;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="400" y="215" width="390" height="125" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="future" value="Planned application layers
HTTP handlers → business logic → data access
Events / registrations / participant export
Staff access protection + email confirmations
Not implemented; DB tooling undecided" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#fff3d6;strokeColor=#b7791f;dashed=1;fontSize=15;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="400" y="385" width="390" height="145" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="db" value="Provider MariaDB 11.8.6
Connectivity OK; app TLS open
No application schema yet" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#fff3d6;strokeColor=#b7791f;dashed=1;fontSize=15;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="860" y="215" width="270" height="110" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="smtp" value="Azure SMTP :587 / STARTTLS
SMTP_SECURE=false; TLS required
Delivery OK; spam review open" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#fff3d6;strokeColor=#b7791f;dashed=1;fontSize=15;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="860" y="410" width="270" height="110" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="guardrail" value="HTTPS → managed app on 127.0.0.1:3000; upload under SSH home.
Open: automatic recovery, safe removal, application DB TLS." style="text;align=left;fontSize=14;fontColor=#854d0e;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="390" y="560" width="740" height="55" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="web" value="Same-origin
assets + /api" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;endArrow=classic;strokeColor=#3973ac;fontSize=13;" edge="1" parent="1" source="browser" target="server"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="layers" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;endArrow=classic;dashed=1;strokeColor=#b7791f;" edge="1" parent="1" source="server" target="future"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="sql" value="SQL" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;endArrow=classic;dashed=1;strokeColor=#b7791f;exitX=1;exitY=0.2;entryX=0;entryY=0.5;" edge="1" parent="1" source="future" target="db"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="mail" value="SMTP" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;endArrow=classic;dashed=1;strokeColor=#b7791f;" edge="1" parent="1" source="future" target="smtp"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="local" value="LOCAL DEVELOPMENT | Host-run Node.js + Docker Compose services (loopback only)" style="rounded=1;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=15;align=left;spacingLeft=20;fillColor=#f5f8fc;strokeColor=#94a3b8;fontSize=17;fontStyle=1;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="40" y="680" width="1120" height="275" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="vite" value="Vite dev server :5173
React + hot reload" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#eaf3ff;strokeColor=#3973ac;fontSize=15;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="70" y="750" width="210" height="80" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="devnode" value="Express :3000
No DB / SMTP on startup" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#eaf3ff;strokeColor=#3973ac;fontSize=15;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="380" y="750" width="230" height="80" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="checks" value="Explicit CLI checks (not HTTP)
check:db → SELECT 1 only
check:smtp → one test email" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#eaf3ff;strokeColor=#3973ac;fontSize=14;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="380" y="855" width="300" height="80" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="localdb" value="MariaDB 11.8.6 :3306
Volume: mariadb-11-8-6-data" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#eaf3ff;strokeColor=#3973ac;fontSize=14;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="810" y="745" width="320" height="80" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="mailpit" value="Mailpit :1025 | inbox UI :8025
No TLS / auth / external delivery
Volume: mailpit-data" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#eaf3ff;strokeColor=#3973ac;fontSize=14;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="810" y="855" width="320" height="80" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="proxy" value="/api proxy" style="endArrow=classic;strokeColor=#3973ac;fontSize=13;" edge="1" parent="1" source="vite" target="devnode"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="dbcheck" value="SQL" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;endArrow=classic;strokeColor=#3973ac;exitX=1;exitY=0.25;entryX=0;entryY=0.5;" edge="1" parent="1" source="checks" target="localdb"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="mailcheck" value="SMTP" style="endArrow=classic;strokeColor=#3973ac;" edge="1" parent="1" source="checks" target="mailpit"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="footer" value="Secrets: server environment / ignored .env only; never frontend bundles. Ports shown are local defaults.
Sources: specs/tech-stack.md, specs/production-environment.md, specs/roadmap.md, README.md and current source." style="text;align=left;fontSize=13;fontColor=#475569;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="40" y="975" width="1120" height="50" as="geometry"/></mxCell> </root></mxGraphModel></diagram></mxfile>
svg.title: Klubcamp solution architecture
svg.desc: Editable diagrams.net architecture. Express serves the deployed HTTPS React SPA and JSON API. Dashed amber denotes planned application layers or remaining operational verification. Hosted MariaDB connectivity and Azure SMTP delivery are verified; application DB TLS, automatic recovery and safe removal remain open. Local development uses Vite, explicit checks, MariaDB 11.8.6 and Mailpit.
svg.text: Solid blue: implemented locally | Dashed amber: planned or not verified in production

text.tspan: One app serves frontend/dist + JSON API
HTTP handlers → business logic → data access
HTTPS → managed app on 127.0.0.1:3000; upload under SSH home.
Open: automatic recovery, safe removal, application DB TLS.

svg.text: LOCAL DEVELOPMENT | Host-run Node.js + Docker Compose services (loopback only)

text.tspan: Secrets: server environment / ignored .env only; never frontend bundles. Ports shown are local defaults.
Sources: specs/tech-stack.md, specs/production-environment.md, specs/roadmap.md, README.md and current source.
